item.title: He Blamed Cold Medicine After His Wife Was Found Dead
item.description: Matthew Phelps called 911 in September 2017 and said he had taken too much Coricidin before waking from a dream to find his wife Lauren dead. Investigators later found she had suffered 123 sharp-force injuries. Phelps pleaded guilty to first-degree murder in 2018 and was sentenced to life without parole.
